title: What do End-to-End Speech Models Learn about Speaker, Language and Channel Information? A Layer-wise and Neuron-level Analysis
reasoning: The paper provides an interpretability analysis of speech models (such as CNNs and Speech Transformers) regarding internal representations of gender, dialect, and channel information.
